description: Script for parsing native package index files (apk and opkg formats) into JSON format for downstream tools, with command-line argument parsing and package processing functions.

methods.name: removesuffix
methods.description: Removes a suffix from a string if it exists, for Python versions before 3.9.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for architecture, source format, manifest flag, and input source.

methods.name: parse_apk
methods.description: Parses APK format JSON text to extract package names and versions, handling ABI suffix removal.

methods.name: parse_opkg
methods.description: Parses opkg format text to extract package names and versions, handling ABI suffix removal.
